title: Pharmacy Coverage Start, Status and End Dates
content:
**Enrollment statement — Pharmacy Benefit.** Pharmacy coverage becomes effective on the plan membership's coverage start date and ends on the membership's termination date or the day before a new pharmacy plan starts after a category change. When coverage ends, the unused OTC allowance is forfeited the same day and approved exceptions end with the coverage.

### Coverage statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Pending | Opened with the plan membership, not yet effective |
| Active | In force |
| Restricted | In force, with the member in the restricted recipient (lock-in) program |
| Terminated | Ended |

### Status changes

| From | To | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| Pending | Active | The Pharmacy Benefit becomes effective with the plan membership |
| Pending | Terminated | The membership is cancelled before it starts |
| Active | Restricted | The member is placed in the lock-in program after notice |
| Restricted | Active | The lock-in period ends or the lock-in is reversed |
| Active | Terminated | The Pharmacy Benefit ends with the membership or a change of plan category |
| Restricted | Terminated | The Pharmacy Benefit ends during a lock-in |

### End dates

| Reason coverage ends | Last day of pharmacy coverage |
|---|---|
| The membership terminates | The membership's termination date |
| A new pharmacy plan starts after a category change | The day before the new plan starts |

On that last day the unused OTC allowance is forfeited, and every approved exception ends with the coverage.
